thread:
Maya: heads-up — acme-inc reported ~2k 504s and sustained p95 spikes against /v1/generate from 09:55-10:05 UTC, they're seeing user-visible timeouts. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/7890 :grimacing:
Priya-CS: they just pinged me, customer says first few tokens succeed then long hangs then 504. very upset about UX.
OpsBot: alert: gateway.request_queue.depth > 900 (hosted-prod) for tenant=acme-inc at 2026-03-18T09:56:12Z. continuous_batcher backlog increased.
Ira: grabbing traces and p95 traces now — any recent deploys or config changes on gateway/ingress?
Sam: no deploys in last 2h. saw autoscaler spin a few more pods ~09:50 but queue depth kept climbing. looks like batching backlog got stuck on a few long seq requests.
Maya: putting customer on notice, working with infra to mitigate. can we early-reject long requests for this tenant?
Alex: probable continuous batching backlog, KV cache spin-up came up earlier in other incidents. can you paste a quick log snippet?
Sam: log snippet from gateway:
```
[2026-03-18T09:56:10Z] gateway DEBUG tenant=acme-inc enqueue_time_ms=1298 queue_depth=976 batch_wait_ms=412 req_len=2400
[2026-03-18T09:56:11Z] batcher WARN  batch_id=0x7f2 enqueue_delay_ms=1280 head_req_timeout=true
[2026-03-18T09:56:12Z] worker ERROR tenant=acme-inc generation_timeout=504 elapsed_ms=120500
```
Maya: that matches customer repro. long requests + continuous batching => head-of-line blocking.
Ira: repro steps from customer: 1) stream open, 2) send long prompt (~2.4k tokens) 3) subsequent parallel small requests time out after ~60s.
Priya-CS: customer provided request ids: r_9832, r_9833, r_9834 — they've attached logs in ticket.
Sam: mitigation plan: (1) enable early_reject for tenant acme-inc (drop requests when queue_depth > 512) (2) bump gateway max_queue_depth from 1024 to 2048 for short term while we scale batchers, (3) add a temporary routing rule to route small requests to a lightweight low-latency model variant.
Maya: can someone run the early_reject change now? we need to stop user-facing 504s ASAP.
Ira: will apply early_reject flag to tenant via org-config now. patch: `orgctl set acme-inc --early_reject=true --early_reject_thresh=512`
DeployBot: config-change: orgctl apply succeeded for tenant=acme-inc at 2026-03-18T09:58:03Z by Ira.
Sam: I'm scaling up batcher pool + adding a shortseq preempt queue. scaling commands run: `infractl scale batchers hosted-prod --count +4` — starting up new workers.
OpsBot: metric: request_504_count decreased from 2100 -> 120 in 10m after early_reject and scale. queue_depth dropped to 230 at 10:04 UTC.
Maya: customer confirmed reduced errors and we're seeing normal p95. Priya escalated they want RCA and permanent fix.
Alex: next steps for root cause: 1) correlate long-seq requests to batcher scheduling; 2) check KV cache hit patterns (cold spin-ups); 3) evaluate a per-tenant queue-depth guard and preemptive scheduling.
Ira: collecting traces and a flamegraph from batcher nodes, will attach to ticket.
Sam: I can implement early_reject as a tenant policy + queue head-preemption in runtime — quick patch and can run canary tomorrow.
Priya-CS: communicating to customer that we've stabilized and will follow up with detailed RCA + timeline.
Maya: thanks everyone — creating incident doc and assigning postmortem. Alex will lead RCA, Ira ops trace, Sam runtime fix, Priya handles customer comms. :thumbsup:
Alex: I'll own the postmortem, will create doc and invite relevant folks. planning follow-up meeting 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC.
Maya: closing thread for now, will update ticket with steps and mitigation summary.
